extracted.intended_audience: public company registrants and their advisors (corporate counsel, investor relations, accountants, auditors), investors, and market participants
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and mandatory rules for registrants to prepare and file climate-related disclosures in SEC registration statements and annual reports, including GHG metrics, governance, risk management, targets, financial effects, and required attestation and data tagging. Covers scope, timing, and presentation requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of Climate-Related Risks
rubrics_metrics.description: A description of any climate-related risks that have materially impacted or are reasonably likely to have a material impact on the registrant, including on its strategy, results of operations, and financial condition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must identify climate-related risks and their material impacts to enable investors to evaluate how such risks affect the company; materiality is assessed with respect to investment and voting decisions. Definitions and examples of climate-related risks and opportunities are provided (Items 1500 and 1502(a)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Time Horizons and the Materiality Determination (Item 1502(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration of relevant time horizons in determining whether climate-related risks are material (Item 1502(a)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclosures should explain the time horizon over which the registrant evaluated materiality and how that horizon affected the materiality determination; the Commission clarifies that 'materiality' refers to importance to investment and voting decisions, not broader policy importance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure Regarding Impacts on Strategy, Business Model, and Outlook (Item 1502)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure of the actual or potential material impacts of climate-related risks on the registrant's strategy, business model, and outlook (Item 1502(b),(c),(d)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes describing how climate-related risks have or could affect products/services, markets, supply chains, capital allocation, and financial planning; cross-references material expenditures disclosure and related financial statement effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transition Plan Disclosure (Items 1500 and 1502(e))
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, disclosure regarding the registrant's activities to mitigate or adapt to a material climate-related risk, including the use of transition plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Should describe the content of any transition plan, milestones, timelines, implementation steps, resource allocation, and how the plan materially affects strategy, operations, or financial condition; may include targets and governance arrangements supporting the plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of Scenario Analysis If Used (Items 1500 and 1502(f))
rubrics_metrics.description: Where a registrant uses scenario analysis to assess climate-related risks, disclose the analysis and its role in the registrant's assessment (Item 1502(f)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe scenarios considered, key assumptions, models, sensitivity of results, time horizons, outputs, and how scenario analysis informed strategy/financial projections; explain limitations and uncertainties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of a Maintained Internal Carbon Price (Item 1502(g))
rubrics_metrics.description: If a registrant uses or maintains an internal carbon price, disclose that fact and relevant details (Item 1502(g)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the carbon price value(s), scope of application, how the price is used in decision-making or planning, and any changes over time; explain its effect on strategy or financial estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governance Disclosure — Board Oversight (Item 1501(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure of the board of directors' oversight of climate-related risks (Item 1501(a)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the board’s processes for overseeing climate-related risks, committees involved, frequency of oversight, information considered by the board, and how oversight has affected governance and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governance Disclosure — Management Oversight (Item 1501(b))
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure of management's role in assessing and managing climate-related risks (Item 1501(b)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify management positions or committees responsible, the processes by which management monitors and manages climate risks, reporting lines to the board, and any changes in management responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk Management Disclosure (Item 1503)
rubrics_metrics.description: A description of any processes the registrant uses to assess or manage material climate-related risks (Item 1503).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain identification, assessment, prioritization, mitigation, monitoring, and internal controls related to climate risks; describe integration with enterprise risk management, and changes to processes over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targets and Goals Disclosure (Item 1504)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure about any targets or goals that have materially affected or are reasonably likely to materially affect the registrant's business, results of operations, or financial condition (Item 1504).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include target definitions, baseline year, scope (e.g., Scope 1/2/3), timeframes, interim milestones, progress to date, governance, and any reliance on carbon offsets or renewable energy credits (RECs) with explanation of their use and limitations (Item 1504(d)).

rubrics_metrics.name: GHG Emissions Disclosure (Item 1505)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to disclose GHG emissions metrics, including Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions on a phased-in basis for certain larger registrants when those emissions are material (Item 1505).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide quantitative Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions metrics, present underlying methodologies and assumptions, timeline for reporting, any exclusions or exceptions, units and boundaries used, and contextual information to allow comparability. The rules phase in Scope 1/2 disclosure and accompanying attestation for larger filers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation of the GHG Emissions Metrics and Underlying Methodologies and Assumptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose how GHG emissions metrics are presented and the methodologies and assumptions used to calculate them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include calculation methods, emission factors, organizational and operational boundaries, data sources, estimation techniques, changes in methodology year-over-year, and any limitations or uncertainties affecting accuracy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusions From the GHG Emissions Disclosure Requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Specified circumstances or items that registrants may exclude from GHG emissions disclosure requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rules identify particular exclusions (e.g., immaterial sources, de minimis categories); registrants must disclose and explain any exclusions and why they apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attestation Over GHG Emissions Disclosure (Item 1506)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement for an attestation report covering required Scope 1 and/or Scope 2 emissions disclosures, including provider qualifications, engagement and report requirements, and additional registrant disclosures (Item 1506).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets provider requirements (independence, qualifications), levels of assurance (phased-in; reasonable vs limited), engagement procedures and reporting elements, registrant supplemental disclosures about the attestation, and rules about voluntary assurance disclosures (Item 1506(e)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Safe Harbor for Certain Climate-Related Disclosures (Item 1507)
rubrics_metrics.description: Safe-harbor provisions applicable to certain climate-related disclosures (Item 1507).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the scope of any forward-looking safe harbor protections, which disclosures qualify, and limits or conditions on protection; see Item 1507 for specifics and interplay with other liabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Statement Effects — Financial Impact Metrics (Article 14)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure of financial impact metrics relating to severe weather events and other natural conditions and their effect on financial statements (Article 14).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registry must disclose metrics quantifying the financial effects (costs, losses, recoveries) of severe weather and other natural conditions, attribution principles, thresholds for disclosure, and presentation guidance within financial statements or notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Statement Effects — Expenditure Effects (Article 14 Rules 14-02(c) and (d))
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure of material expenditures related to severe weather events and other natural conditions, including scope, disclosure threshold, attribution principle, recoveries, and presentation (Rules 14-02(c),(d),(e),(f),(g)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain what expenditures are included, apply the disclosure threshold, describe attribution of expenditures to climate events, disclose any recoveries or insurance proceeds, treatment of carbon offsets/RECs, and present disclosure consistent with financial statement formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Estimates and Assumptions (Rule 14-02(h))
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure of financial estimates and assumptions underlying reported financial impacts of climate-related events (Rule 14-02(h)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide assumptions, estimation methods, sensitivity analyses, ranges of estimates, and explanation of how estimates affect reported amounts and financial statement comparability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Disclosures in the Financial Statements (Rule 14-01(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing when and how climate-related disclosures (including effects of severe weather events and other natural conditions) are included in the registrant's audited financial statements (Rule 14-01(a)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies whether disclosures are presented within financial statements, notes, or elsewhere in filings; requires consistency with accounting rules and attribution principles, and may require changes to Form content or schedules (see Article 14 and related amendments).

rubrics_metrics.name: Material Expenditures Disclosure Requirement (linked to Item 1502 and Item 1504)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to disclose material expenditures related to climate-related risks, provided either as part of strategy disclosure (Item 1502) or targets and goals disclosure (Item 1504).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material expenditures disclosure will be phased in (timing described in compliance schedule); registrants should include expenditures that materially affect business and financial condition, explain measurement/basis, and ensure consistency with financial statement disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation and Submission of the Climate-Related Disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements about where and how climate-related disclosures must be presented and submitted in Commission filings (location, filing vs furnishing, and format).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies filing locations (e.g., Form 10-K, registration statements), whether disclosures are 'filed' (subject to certain liabilities) or 'furnished', expectations for cross-references, and the requirement to tag specified disclosures in structured data (Item 1508 and Regulation S-T).

rubrics_metrics.name: Structured Data Requirement (Item 1508)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to provide certain climate-related disclosures in structured data format (Item 1508).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mandates tagging of specified climate disclosures using the Commission's structured data standards; includes details about required data fields and machine-readable presentation to improve comparability and investor access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registrants Subject to the Climate-Related Disclosure Rules and Affected Forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Specification of which registrants (LAFs, accelerated filers, SRCs, EGCs, etc.) are subject to which requirements and which SEC forms are affected (various Forms S-1, S-3, 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rules set different obligations and phase-in schedules depending on filer status; tables and rule text identify affected forms and instructions (see section II.L and appendices with form instructions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Phase-in Periods and Compliance Dates (II.O)
rubrics_metrics.description: Phased compliance dates for different registrant categories and for different elements of the disclosure requirements (e.g., Scope 1/2 metrics, attestation, material expenditures).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compliance and phase-in schedules are specified by filer category; some items are effective immediately while others are phased in over fiscal years (see section II.O for detailed timelines and transition periods).

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment for Purposes of the Securities Act and the Exchange Act
rubrics_metrics.description: How climate-related disclosures are treated under the Securities Act and Exchange Act (e.g., whether furnished vs filed) and attendant liability considerations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules explain when disclosures will be considered filed (subject to Section 11 liability if included in or incorporated into registration statements) versus furnished, and the implications for investor protections and liability exposure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attestation Provider Requirements (Item 1506(b))
rubrics_metrics.description: Qualifications, independence, and other requirements for providers who perform attestation over GHG emissions disclosures (Item 1506(b)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets standards for who may provide attestation (professional qualifications, independence), engagement conduct, report content, and oversight; registrants must disclose provider identity and relevant qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: GHG Emissions Attestation Engagement and Report Requirements (Item 1506(a)(2) and (c))
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific engagement procedures and required elements of the attestation report over GHG emissions (Item 1506(a)(2) and (c)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attestation reports must include scope, methodology, findings, assurance level, limitations, and any reservations; engagement documentation and provider communications required; registrant must disclose aspects of the engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Disclosure by the Registrant Regarding Attestation (Item 1506(d))
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplemental disclosure obligations by registrants related to the attestation engagement and attestation findings (Item 1506(d)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrants must disclose details such as the date of the attestation report, any modifications, and how attestation findings affect the registrant's disclosures or controls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of Voluntary Assurance (Item 1506(e))
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing a registrant's disclosure of voluntary assurance beyond the required attestation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a registrant discloses voluntarily obtained assurance, it must describe the scope, provider, assurance level, and relationship to required disclosures to avoid misleading investors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasonable Alternatives and Consideration of Alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: The rulemaking discusses alternative approaches considered (e.g., principles-based approach, different attestation approaches, different thresholds, furnished vs filed), which inform how disclosures should be structured.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although the Commission adopted specified rules, registrants and advisors should be aware of the alternatives evaluated (see section IV.F) to understand the policy choices and where flexibility may exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contextual and Comparative Disclosures (including Use of Third-Party Frameworks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose contextual information to aid investor comparability, and describe use of third-party reporting frameworks where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrants should identify any external frameworks used (e.g., TCFD), explain how framework mappings were applied, and provide context to allow investors to compare disclosures across companies and periods.
